case.summary: The alert was triggered by an autonomous monitor detecting seven online authorizations under $5 within an hour on card C04597-K2, specifically flagging transaction 3544752 for $0.97. Graph evidence showed that while the device profile had been used 11 times previously on this card, the transaction model scored an earlier transaction for $15.90 at 0.91. The policy engine reached a final verdict of fraud with a 94% probability, identifying a card-not-present fraud pattern. The final actions taken were to block the card and create a case.
